verdict.rationale: Railway's homepage directly claims "All logs in one place," which matches the core of the story, but this is a one-line marketing claim. Nothing in the pack shows that build, deploy and runtime logs are each covered in that unified view, and the Slack agent reading logs is a separate access path, not the unified view itself. Missing for 10: in-depth docs showing build, deploy and runtime logs together in one view, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view all my build, deploy, and runtime logs in one place

citations.quote: All logs in one place. Spot issues without switching tools.
